newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Creditanstalt eyes new export credit agreements.
newsitem.headline: Creditanstalt eyes new export credit agreements.

text.p: Creditanstalt-Bankverein said on Monday it was preparing framework credit agreements with institutions in Argentina, Indonesia, Venezuela and Vietnam.
Regina Prehofer, who heads the bank's financing and consulting division, told a news conference Creditanstalt already had agreements with 30 institutions in 15 countries.
She said the export credit business contributed around 360 million schillings to group operating profit, which stood at 6.1 billion schillings last year.
"It is a secure business because in some form the Austrian Kontrollbank covers more than 90 percent of risk," Prehofer said.
Creditanstalt rated China, Indonesia, Algeria, Russia and Egypt important markets.
